verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's quickstart says the OpenAI SDK can be pointed at OpenRouter as a drop-in replacement, and its API reference says it normalizes one schema across models and providers. A community user corroborates switching models with the same API key and the same request with minimal effort. Missing for 10: the evidence doesn't show the base-URL-and-key-only configuration explicitly, and no independent hands-on report confirms existing OpenAI SDK code working unmodified.
